narrative.intro: Humana Government Business has $4.6B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The profile records two awards for the current fiscal year, with an average award size of $2.3B. Obligations fell 29.9% year over year. Historical fiscal-year obligations show a peak near $8B in FY24, then a decline to $6.5B in FY25 and $4.6B in FY26. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). This summary focuses on the size and trajectory of obligations and the current award footprint rather than contract-level detail.
